Coordinates: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) for the buildings, OneMap for the School of Law. Stalls inside a food court have no coordinates of their own and are placed within about 40 m of it. Other SMU outlets in that directory (Subway, Snappy Bowls, Nature Cafe, BRAEK, Onalu and others) are not imported yet. Earlier venue sets are in data/archive/venues.
